observation: Direct 68010 read taps with data/mask capture in independent 1200-frame no-input and coin_start runs observe identical 625989 reads from the ADSP serial/output buffer. Each run contains 106 paired blocks: PC 0x02F0C2 reads a count at 0x810000, the transfer loop reads the block, and PC 0x02F0E2 reads 0xFFFF at 0x810000 + (count * 2). The reads span 0x810000-0x813f50 and come from PCs 0x02F0C2/0x02F0E2 and transfer-loop PCs 0x02248E/0x02249A. This runtime evidence corroborates the existing instruction-trace edge from the buffer into the GSP FIFO; no buffer writes were observed in the 600-frame title-path write probe.
